definitions.explanation: A tax imposed on goods when they are transported across international borders, typically collected by customs authorities.

examples.japanese: {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}に{関税|かんぜい}がかかる。
examples.english: Customs duties apply to imported goods.

examples.japanese: {関税|かんぜい}{撤廃|てっぱい}が{議論|ぎろん}されている。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関税|かんぜい}がかかる (customs duties apply)
- {関税|かんぜい}を{払|はら}う (to pay tariffs)
- {関税|かんぜい}{率|りつ} (tariff rate)
- {関税|かんぜい}{撤廃|てっぱい} (tariff elimination)
- {関税|かんぜい}{障壁|しょうへき} (tariff barrier)

RELATED TERMS:
- {税関|ぜいかん} (customs office)
- {輸入税|ゆにゅうぜい} (import tax)
